subject.title: feat(attach): record + resume the Claude cli session bound to an attach session

question: Should OpenClaw accept `attach.adopt` as the permanent operator-admin mechanism for binding an externally spawned Claude session to persisted Gateway session state once the current attach isolation contract is restored?
rationale: The feature deliberately lets an external interactive harness affect persisted session identity and imported transcript state; code review can require strict isolation, but the permanent authorization and ownership boundary needs explicit maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Accept after security rebase
options.body: Rebase onto current main, keep strict token-only attach configuration, isolate the resume/adoption delta, and then review the new RPC and persistence contract.

options.title: Keep recording without resume
options.body: Allow transcript adoption/import but omit automatic Claude session resume until the persisted-session authorization model is separately approved.

options.title: Pause the adoption API
options.body: Keep the existing attach launcher only and continue the design discussion in the canonical tracking issue.

recommendation.title: Accept after security rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, keep strict token-only attach configuration, isolate the resume/adoption delta, and then review the new RPC and persistence contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the attach design history and authored both merged prerequisites, making them the best available routing owner for a focused maintainer decision.
